column1: # Where tools/check-source-currency.sh finds the newest release of a source
# whose manifest row (tools/fetch-sources.sh) declares "rule", and which of
# upstream's releases the pin may move to. Tab-separated:
#   name    the source, as in the manifest
#   shape   listing: a page read for every match of the pattern
#           api: a JSON answer read for every value of a key
#   where   the page or API URL, on the project's own host
#   match   listing: an ERE whose first group is the version (no "@")
#           api: the key, tag_name or name ("v" is dropped from a value)
#           series  the pin's series only (3.12.x for 3.12.5)
#           major   the pin's major version only
#           even    even minors only: an odd minor is a development series
#           drop90  no X.Y.9N: freedesktop numbers release candidates so
# The pinned series: a 3.13 exists but is not a drop-in.
# A major bump is not a currency fix.
# The front page names the current release; newer tarballs are betas.
